motivation: byte-identical residual merging is exact but misses states that differ only by internal-variable names

candidate.boundary_schedule: remaining boundary variables are pinned and may not be renamed
candidate.merge_rule: merge only after an explicit variable bijection is constructed and verified to map residual CNF A exactly onto residual CNF B
candidate.aggregation: multiplicities add; no representative contribution is discarded
candidate.search_policy: color-refinement plus deterministic candidate bijection; no permutation/backtracking enumeration

captain_obvious_guard.required: branch one scheduled boundary variable, simplify all current quotient states, then merge certified-isomorphic residuals immediately

exactness_claim_under_test: a verified internal-variable renaming with all remaining boundary variables fixed preserves every future occupancy histogram under the frozen continuation schedule
frozen_controls: renaming_killer_family_from_previous_gate must collapse without changing the exact histogram
remaining-boundary pinning must prevent illegal swaps across scheduled boundary variables
explicit wrong bijection must be rejected by exact verifier
empty-clause contradiction state must remain preserved
64 seeded random small formulas must match independent full assignment enumeration

adversarial_family.name: STAR_VS_PATH_SELECTOR
adversarial_family.construction: for selector x_i, gated 3-CNF leaves either an i-edge star or i-edge path on internal variables; both sides contain i clauses
adversarial_family.reason_for_use: component edge count identifies selector index i and star/path degree sequence identifies its bit, so residuals are pairwise non-isomorphic under variable renaming
adversarial_family.purpose: test whether renaming-isomorphism quotient can still have 2^k exact classes on polynomial-size inputs
